verdict.rationale: Sprinto is a SaaS compliance platform with a Developer API, so issuing scoped credentials is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows that the API playground needs an admin account and "a valid API key". Nothing documents scoping, permission granularity, read-only keys, or agent-specific least-privilege credentials, so a generic API key does not satisfy this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
